sources.fact: Latest listed version 12, deprecated/EOL TBD; published migration policy describes six months.
HTTPS ads-api.x.com, Ads-approved app/developer and user account access required; bearer OAuth 2 is insufficient.
Three-legged user access tokens can be revoked; static developer credentials support the app owner's single-account use. No refresh-token flow is asserted.

General callback docs allow local loopback and require exact registration. OAuth 1 app permissions are read/read-write, not OAuth 2 scope strings. Registered Ads app compatibility is untested; browser OAuth belongs to O2.

sources.quote: Include draft campaigns results in your request.
sources.fact: v12 GET accounts and accounts/:account_id/campaigns support count/cursor. with_draft=true includes drafts. Campaign response exposes entity_status and currency. Request account echo binds the campaign page.

v12 GET stats/accounts/:account_id: seven days maximum, twenty IDs, whole hours, TOTAL, one placement. ACCOUNT supports ENGAGEMENT impressions; BILLING and clicks are unsupported at ACCOUNT level and are projected as null. CAMPAIGN supports ENGAGEMENT/BILLING impressions, clicks and billed_charge_local_micro. Supported metrics may be null. Response contains time_series_length, id_data and echoed params. R1 supports ACCOUNT/CAMPAIGN and three documented placements only; no cross-entity or placement totals are inferred.

sources.quote: utilize the ad account level rate limit
sources.fact: Account rate headers take precedence over user headers. Synchronous analytics: 250 per 15 minutes. Global account reads: five per 15 minutes. Plugin returns pacing integers and stops on 429; no retry engine.
Requested signer version, MIT, bundled declarations. Publication was checked by the Coordinator review; integration resolution/install remains pending.
Override instance getNonce/getTimeStamp with injected IDs/clock; sign the same fixed URL/query passed to fetch. HMAC-SHA1 uses Node crypto.

v12 campaign POST defaults ACTIVE; OM sends PAUSED. Funding/name/daily micros/budget_optimization LINE_ITEM are explicit; standard_delivery belongs on the line item. Scoped entity GET verifies funding, currency, budget and paused status.

v12 line-item POST requires campaign_id, objective, placements, product_type, start_time and end_time. Fixed WEBSITE_CLICKS/PROMOTED_TWEETS/ALL_ON_TWITTER/MAX/LINK_CLICKS mapping uses an explicit positive bid, daily budget, standard delivery and PAUSED. GET normalizes placements array and ISO times.

Targeting POST supports LOCATION, resolved targeting_value, line_item_id and EQ. Specific criterion GET exposes ID, parent, targeting_type/value and deleted. Documented ordinary inclusive response omits operator_type; an explicit conflicting operator rejects. No location search/value is inferred.

Promoted-tweets POST attaches existing tweet_ids to line_item_id, returns data array; entity GET returns one data object. No writable status/PUT exists. The attachment status can be ACTIVE while serving is prevented by both PAUSED parents. IDs remain strings.

POST /12/measurement/conversions/:pixel_id uses JSON conversions with conversion_time, event_id, identifiers.hashed_email and conversion_id dedupe. HTTP 200 and one processed event are required; account echo must match. Server-resolved existing pixel/event/account binding, contacts SHA256 hash and current grant/consent are prerequisites. No resend or per-event receipt endpoint is asserted.
